title: Quotient-tower completed pullback adjunction and compositor unit equation
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, $A=\mathcal O_E$, and $\varpi$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X''\xrightarrow hX'\xrightarrow gX$ be morphisms of noetherian finite-dimensional schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible. Use their small pro-etale sites and canonical inverse images [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For $W=X,X',X''$, put $B_W=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/\varpi^n)_W$, with projections $\pi_{W,n}$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], and $E_W=B_W[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-section-localization]. Use module sheaves, sheaf tensor products and ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For a morphism $u:V\to W$, let $d_{u,n}:u^{-1}(A/\varpi^n)_W\to(A/\varpi^n)_V$ be the canonical constant-section map and $c_u:u^{-1}B_W\to B_V$ the map with components $d_{u,n}u^{-1}\pi_{W,n}$ [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Set $P_u=B_V\otimes^L_{u^{-1}B_W}u^{-1}(-)$, with canonical ordinary composition $a:P_hP_g\xrightarrow\sim P_{g\circ h}$ and identity $e:P_{\mathrm{id}}\xrightarrow\sim\mathrm{id}$ [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons]. Let $\mathscr D_W^{\mathrm{comp}}\subset D(B_W)$ be the full category of locally derived $(\varpi)$-complete objects: $M$ belongs to it when $R\mathcal Hom_{B_W|_U}(B_W|_U[1/t],M|_U)=0$ for every site object $U$ and every section $t\in(\varpi)B_W(U)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. Denote its completion reflector with its specified unit by $\Lambda_W,\eta_W$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-koszul-completion-reflector]. For $u:V\to W$, let $\widehat P_u$ and $\gamma_{u,K}:P_uK\to\widehat P_uK$ be the actual strict finite-quotient-tower pullback and quotient augmentation of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Give ordinary $P_u\dashv Ru_*$ the specified derived adjunction of [lem-sfb-ringed-derived-monoidal-comparisons].
Then on $\mathscr D_W^{\mathrm{comp}}$ there is a canonical identification $\widehat P_u=\Lambda_VP_u$ carrying $\gamma_{u,K}$ to $\eta_{V,P_uK}$, compatible with restriction to constant coefficients and the finite-quotient/Koszul completion equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. The functor $Ru_*$ preserves these full complete categories, and $\widehat P_u\dashv Ru_*|_{\mathscr D_V^{\mathrm{comp}}}$ has Hom bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}(\widehat P_uK,L)\xrightarrow{-\circ\gamma_{u,K}}\operatorname{Hom}(P_uK,L)\xrightarrow\sim\operatorname{Hom}(K,Ru_*L).$$
Let $\widehat a:\widehat P_h\widehat P_g\xrightarrow\sim\widehat P_{g\circ h}$ be the conjugate, for precisely these restricted adjunctions and their composite adjunction [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction, lem-weil-pbc-conjugate-iso-unit-equation], of the canonical direct-image composition comparison; let $\widehat e:\widehat P_{\mathrm{id}}\xrightarrow\sim\mathrm{id}$ be its identity analogue. For every complete $K$ the specified maps satisfy
$$\widehat a_K\,\gamma_{h,\widehat P_gK}\,P_h(\gamma_{g,K})=\gamma_{g\circ h,K}\,a_K,\qquad \widehat e_K\,\gamma_{\mathrm{id},K}=e_K.$$
These equations use the actual quotient-tower units and the ordinary adjunction-compatible compositor, and are equations of natural transformations before any unit is assumed invertible. They fix the same comparisons under the quotient-tower/reflector identification, rather than merely giving isomorphic endpoints. There is no constructibility or boundedness restriction on $K$ in the complete categories and no assumption that $u^{-1}B_W\to B_V$ is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Identify the intrinsic complete predicate with the singleton Koszul invertible-unit predicate using the already proved wfComplete_iff. Transport the principal local RHom test to the explicit small completed site by the native slice local-test and local-divisibility restriction theorems and the standard module-equivalence comparison (on the exact AsSmall.{0} site, preserving its Hom universe). Apply principalLocallyComplete_iff to the image ideal of the global uniformizer and ringedKoszulCompletionReflector. The existing completed_fiber_strict_limit_comparison identifies that reflector unit with the published wfCompletionUnit; reflect invertibility through the site equivalence. This proves complete_iff_local without changing its slice universes.

proof.text: Use the actual reflection adjunction of the full intrinsic-complete subcategory and the Hom bijection of wfCompletionReflector. wfComplete_iff identifies their predicates. For each object, construct the unique unit-preserving isomorphism by the two Hom bijections; injectivity after precomposition with the unit proves naturality, the inverse identities and uniqueness. Naturality of the specified Koszul unit follows directly from apply_symm_apply for the Hom bijection of wfCompletionReflector; no Weil tensor-product construction is needed. This proves koszul_identification.

Reuse pbcActualCompletedPullback_tower, which already compares the actual strict quotient tower with ordinary pullback followed by completion and identifies its exact augmentation. Transport the existing intrinsic-completeness witness across each component isomorphism to prove pull_complete; the same unique natural isomorphism, with componentwise unit equation, proves reflector_identification. Thus no second coefficient-map or finite-quotient construction is needed here.

For a complete object L, completeUnit_iff makes its actual completion unit invertible. The existing pbcActualDirectCompletionIso_exists has equation eta_(G L) followed by its comparison equals G(eta_L). The right hand side and comparison are isomorphisms, so eta_(G L) is invertible. completeUnit_iff gives push_complete. This is the existing unit-normalized direct-image/completion comparison, with no invertibility assumption on structural coefficient maps.

For constant_identification, transport the Koszul comparison in CompletedConstantPresentationData along the chosen derived representative isomorphism, using naturality of the constant completion unit. Compose it with reflector_identification and koszul_identification, then restrict coefficients and use ConstantCompletion.completion_restriction. The resulting component isomorphism carries gamma to the uncompleted constant completion unit. Its Hom bijection, supplied by koszul_quotient_reflector, proves naturality and uniqueness of the componentwise isomorphisms.

The ordinary completion reflector Hom bijection and reflector_identification make precomposition with gamma bijective into a complete target. Compose this bijection with pbcActualDerivedAdjunction and the fully faithful inclusion Hom equivalence. Prove source naturality using gamma.naturality and ordinary Hom source naturality, and target naturality using ordinary Hom target naturality. Mathlib Adjunction.mkOfHomEquiv constructs the required adjunction. Equality of the prescribed Hom bijections, evaluated on identities, makes its unit and hence its adjunction unique.

For two specified adjunctions, expand homEquiv through the unit. Mathlib unit_conjugateEquiv and naturality of the conjugate transformation prove the transpose equation for an isomorphism of left adjoints. The restricted right comparison is recovered through the fully faithful inclusion. Apply this equation to the completed compositor and to the ordinary pullback comparison. Expanding the completed composite Hom bijection twice and source naturality of the ordinary second adjunction shows that gamma_g, gamma_h and any completed map have the same transpose as its completed transpose. At the identity of the completed composite pullback, the two conjugate equations and the normalized completed Hom formula therefore give equal ordinary composite transposes. Their injectivity proves compositor_unit, componentwise and hence as natural transformations.

proof.text: Use the same conjugate transpose equation with the identity adjunction. The completed identity transposes to the inverse restricted direct-image identity. Full faithfulness identifies its underlying map with the inverse ordinary direct-image identity, which is the transpose of the specified ordinary pullback identity by its definition as a conjugate. The completed Hom formula and injectivity of the ordinary Hom equivalence prove identity_unit. No ordinary-pullback completion unit is inverted.
